title: AttestationBundle
description: A complete governance bundle for a single graph execution. Assembled from all ProjectBundleStepEntry objects collected during a graph run. Submitted to Provider 02's registerProjectBundle endpoint for CER issuance.

bundleId.description: Unique identifier for this governance bundle (UUID v4)

threadId.description: Thread/session identifier linking multiple graph executions

steps.description: Ordered sequence of node execution steps forming the governance DAG

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when graph execution started

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when graph execution completed or terminated

terminalPath.description: Terminal path classification: happy_path (success), nemo_block (policy violation), cbf_block (safety barrier), loop_breaker (iteration limit), unknown (unclassifiable/fallback)
